$comment: Component audit baselines. ONE baseline per component: the fixes-included state of the component's LAST audit — derived by tracing post-review fix commits (fix commits are usually not stated in reports). Every deployed pin is diffed against this single baseline, restricted to componentPaths — git pathspecs, where :(exclude) entries scope out source files that are not part of any deployed contract's compilation unit. Pins that predate the baseline carry a naturalBaseline: the audit whose fixes-included state the deployed code actually matches, plus the audits that reviewed the pin→baseline delta. Derivations reference PRs/commits/tags verifiable in the public repos.

The later PR #169 merge 084b3228 adds a comment rewording in EthereumVaultConnector.sol (97d2c12) and EVCUtil changes (16c1745, a85425a) outside componentPaths. Registry entries dated later do not displace it: cantina-evc-2024 is the competition report whose reviewed revision (tag cantina-contest, 2024-05-20) PREDATES these fixes, and yaudit-evc-2026-setsize is a feature review (SET_MAX_ELEMENTS 10->100) commissioned for the Gondor/Polymarket integration and deployed only on Polygon — it covers that pin's delta rather than anchoring the component. Final derived from the fix-PR history -> medium.

baseline.derivation: The contract compiles EVCUtil.sol from its EVC submodule. Baseline = EVCUtil at EVC v1.0.1 (a7d3c29e; identical in b9d557a8 and 4538f073), the version the audited contracts that depend on it compile: the EulerEarn reviews (Sigma Prime, Certora and Pashov 2025, all on EVC v1.0.1) cover code calling its _msgSenderOnlyEVCAccountOwner, and the Securitize, SwapVerifier, hook and ERC20Synth reviews cover code calling its _haveCommonOwner and _getAddressPrefix. Anchor = Pashov's EulerEarn review, the latest of them that calls a v1.0.1 addition. Earlier EVC versions predate this baseline; v1.0.2 adds the isValidSignature check (883f048).

yAudit (Electisec) is the last audit of the V1 Securitize factory and vault (reviewed commit 101860e5). Its report names the fixes of its two fixed findings: 'Fixed in: bb0bb5' (frozen accounts could still borrow against frozen collateral) and 'Fixed in: 4b102cd' (immutable complianceService); the third was acknowledged. Baseline = 4b102cd8, the later fix. The Pashov review (final 06c0817d) predates it and its fixes are in the baseline. No componentPaths file changed from 4b102cd8 to the deploy commit dec63c2a; the V1 sources left master with the V2 commit 644a1917.

The contract compiles SafeERC20Permit2Lib.sol from its euler-earn submodule. Pashov's EulerEarn review covers it; baseline = the report's stated fixes-review commit b95775f4 (the euler-earn component's baseline). The Permit2 allowance check and ERC20 fallback (0a285ce, c01d5e5, 2026-10-23) come after it.

Baseline = final reviewed commit. Enigma Dark reviewed exactly the PR #432 diff (6a84e9f6...644a1917: the V2 vault, the V2 factory and its interface) with ZERO findings at every severity, so no fix window exists. The vault implementation contracts under it predate PR #432 and were reviewed by Pashov (pashov-erc4626-vault-securitize-2025) and yAudit (yaudit-erc4626-vault-securitize-2025). No componentPaths file changed on master after 644a1917.
